source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && python3 -c "
import numpy as np
np.random.seed(42)

# melt per-episode scores
melt_int = np.array([-100,0,3,-100,-100,-100,0,-100,0,-100,0,3,-100,0,0,-100,-100,-100,-100,0], dtype=float)
melt_det = np.array([0,0,3,3,0,0,0,0,0,-100,0,3,0,0,0,0,-100,0,-100,0], dtype=float)
melt_diff = melt_det - melt_int

# change-the-state-of-matter-of per-episode scores
cs_int = np.array([-100,0,3,-100,-100,-100,0,-100,0,-100,0,3,-100,0,0,-100,-100,-100,-100,0], dtype=float)
cs_det = np.array([0,0,4,3,0,-100,0,0,0,-100,0,3,0,0,0,-100,0,0,0,0], dtype=float)
cs_diff = cs_det - cs_int

n_boot = 10000
for name, diff in [('melt', melt_diff), ('change-state', cs_diff)]:
    means = []
    for _ in range(n_boot):
        idx = np.random.choice(len(diff), size=len(diff), replace=True)
        means.append(diff[idx].mean())
    means = np.array(means)
    lo, hi = np.percentile(means, [5, 95])
    print(f'{name}: mean_diff={diff.mean():.2f}, 90%CI=[{lo:.2f}, {hi:.2f}], CI_lower>0: {lo > 0}')

# Combined (pooled)
all_diff = np.concatenate([melt_diff, cs_diff])
means = []
for _ in range(n_boot):
    idx = np.random.choice(len(all_diff), size=len(all_diff), replace=True)
    means.append(all_diff[idx].mean())
means = np.array(means)
lo, hi = np.percentile(means, [5, 95])
print(f'pooled: mean_diff={all_diff.mean():.2f}, 90%CI=[{lo:.2f}, {hi:.2f}], CI_lower>0: {lo > 0}')
"
